memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: reports independent with ADLs, walks 2 km daily, no difficulty climbing stairs. cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5, recall of three words intact, clock drawing normal. falls: no falls in last 12 months, gait steady, timed up-and-go 10 seconds (normal). medicines: 4 regular (timolol 0.5% eye drops BD, latanoprost 0.005% eye drops HS, levothyroxine 50 mcg OD, calcium with vitamin D3 OD); no polypharmacy. mood: reports good spirits, denies anxiety or low mood. carers: husband Ramesh, spouse. goals: "I want to stay active and keep walking in the park without pain."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
timolol 0.5% eye drops, one drop in each eye twice daily
latanoprost 0.005% eye drops, one drop in each eye at bedtime
levothyroxine 50 mcg tablet, take once daily in the morning
calcium 500 mg with vitamin D3 400 IU tablet, take once daily with breakfast

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Intraocular pressure: RE 18 mmHg, LE 19 mmHg (ref 10-21)
TSH: 4.2 mIU/L (ref 0.4-4.0) – slightly high
Free T4: 11.2 pmol/L (ref 9.0-19.0)
Serum 25‑OH vitamin D: 22 ng/mL (ref 30-100) – insufficient

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Visual field testing ( Humphrey 24-2 ): both eyes within normal limits, no glaucomatous defect. Optic disc assessment: cup-to-disc ratio 0.3 RE, 0.35 LE, healthy rim.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: still independent, occasional knee ache after long walks, manages with paracetamol PRN. cognition: Mini-Cog not repeated this visit (annual screen due next April). falls: no falls in last 12 months, gait slightly antalgic on right, timed up-and-go 11 seconds (borderline). medicines: 5 regular (timolol BD, latanoprost HS, levothyroxine 50 mcg OD, calcium+vit D3 OD, paracetamol SOS PRN not counted); polypharmacy flag – request Beers‑criteria review. mood: reports mild frustration with knee pain, denies depression. carers: husband Ramesh, spouse. goals: "I want to walk without knee discomfort and keep my eye pressure stable."

memories.author: D06

all other medications unchanged

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: reports increased right knee pain on stairs, limits walking to 1 km; uses topical analgesic occasionally. cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (one‑point drop), plan for fuller cognitive assessment next visit. falls: one fall in last 12 months (tripped over rug, no injury), gait slow, timed up-and-go 13 seconds – raised fall risk; advise strength exercises and supportive footwear. medicines: 6 regular (timolol BD, latanoprost HS, levothyroxine 75 mcg OD, calcium+vit D3 OD, paracetamol SOS PRN, topical diclofenac gel PRN); polypharmacy – request Beers review. mood: reports low mood due to mobility limits, denies suicidal ideation. carers: husband Ramesh, spouse. goals: "I want to reduce knee pain and avoid another fall."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
diclofenac sodium 1% gel, apply to affected knee 3‑4 times daily as needed
all other medications unchanged

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: knee pain improved with gel, walks 1.5 km comfortably; occasional paracetamol for breakthrough pain. cognition: Mini-Cog repeated, score 4/5 – normal. falls: no new falls, gait improved, timed up-and-go 10 seconds. medicines: 6 regular (timolol BD, latanoprost HS, levothyroxine 75 mcg OD, calcium+vit D3 OD, paracetamol SOS PRN, topical diclofenac gel PRN); polypharmacy – note Beers review pending. mood: reports better mood, enjoys gardening. carers: husband Ramesh, spouse. goals: "I want to maintain current activity level and keep eye pressures low."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: ADLs independent, walks 2 km daily, no knee pain; reports occasional mild glare in bright light. cognition: Mini-Cog not due yet (last Jan). falls: no falls in last 12 months, gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 seconds. medicines: 6 regular (timolol BD, latanoprost HS, levothyroxine 100 mcg OD, calcium+vit D3 OD, paracetamol SOS PRN, topical diclofenac gel PRN); polypharmacy – Beers review completed, no inappropriate meds. mood: reports feeling well, enjoys time with grandchildren. carers: husband Ramesh, spouse. goals: "I want to stay healthy and continue enjoying my hobbies."

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2026-07-08 at 10:30 am with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: remains independent, walks 2‑3 km, no ocular symptoms, knee comfortable. cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5. falls: none, gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 seconds. medicines: 6 regular (timolol BD, latanoprost HS, levothyroxine 100 mcg OD, calcium+vit D3 OD, paracetamol SOS PRN, topical diclofenac gel PRN); polypharmacy – no concerns. mood: positive, reports good quality of life. carers: husband Ramesh, spouse. goals: "I want to keep my vision and joints healthy for as long as possible."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Weight‑bearing X‑ray both knees: joint space preserved, mild osteophytosis bilaterally, no significant cartilage loss. No fracture or dislocation.
